cookies.s1_text: Cookies are small files stored on your device that help us remember your preferences, such as your theme and language.
cookies.s2_text: We use essential cookies for authentication and preference storage. We do not use cookies for advertising purposes.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Premium and OharaTracker.

items.a: Yes, you can try Premium without any risk. You have the flexibility to cancel at any time before the renewal date, and you won't lose access to the premium features. In fact, you can cancel as soon as you subscribe to try out Premium for a month.

items.q: What happens if I upgrade or downgrade?
items.a: We pro-rate your subscription, making it seamless for you. If you upgrade, you'll only pay the difference. Conversely, if you downgrade, you'll receive credit towards your next payment cycle, so you'll pay less next time.

items.q: What happens to my customizations when I unsubscribe?
items.a: We retain all your custom changes on our servers, but you lose access to them when you unsubscribe. If you subscribe again, they automatically reappear.

items.q: How can I cancel my subscription?
items.a: Go to Settings → Pricing. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

items.q: When will Elite tier be introduced?
items.a: No release date yet. Users will be able to upgrade when available.

items.q: How long do features remain in Early Access?
items.a: There is no fixed duration. Features leave Early Access when ready.
